summary: Onto Innovation Inc. filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $1.5 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, plus an additional $200 million exercised by initial purchasers. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with no regular interest, maturing June 1, 2031. They were offered via Rule 144A to QIBs. This is a straight debt financing, not a special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event. The filing is routine capital-raising.
